# fragata-server-netbox

> Synchronizes pools managed by Fragata with Netbox

## Usage

Like all other fragata-server plugins, it can be configured directly via
the web interface, see [the plugin documentation](https://github.com/6a8i/fragata-orchestrator/blob/main/docs/docs/manage-your-infrastructure/advanced.md#netbox).
